text:
[Council File 26-1592; CD 3]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (BLUMENFIELD - JURADO) and RESOLUTION relative to issuing Multifamily Housing Revenue Bonds, in an amount not to exceed $40,000,000 to finance the new construction of the 96-unit multifamily housing project known as Valleris on Ventura (Project) located at 23022 Ventura Boulevard, Los Angeles in Council District 3.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. CONSIDER the results of the Tax Equity and Fiscal Responsibility Act of 1982 (TEFRA) public hearing held on September 21, 2026 for the Project.
2. ADOPT the accompanying TEFRA RESOLUTION approving the issuance of bonds in an amount not to exceed $40,000,000 for the new construction of a 96-unit multifamily housing project located at 23022 Ventura Boulevard in Council District 3.
